title: Justify as a judge's act: defend the humble; condemn bribery
source_text: IV. His adde loca ubi justificare ponitur tanquam actio judicis, veluti quum Psal. 82. jubentur judices, quibus eo loco tribuitur Deorum, & filiorum Dei appellatio, justificare humilem & orphanum; apud Esaiam vero cap. 5. vae dicitur judicibus qui improbum justificant pro muneribus.
pass_a_gloss: Add to these the places where to justify is set as the action of a judge, as when in Psalm 82 the judges, to whom in that place is attributed the appellation of gods and sons of God, are commanded to justify the humble and the orphan; but in Isaiah chapter 5 woe is said to the judges who justify the wicked for gifts.
pass_b_english: Justify also names a judge's act: Ps 82 justify the humble and orphan.
Isa 5 woe on judges who justify the wicked for bribes.
